en: A black and white image of a European street scene. The street is lined with two-story buildings with steeply-pitched roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central European architecture. There are market stalls or tables set up along the street with several people, including women in long dresses typical of late 19th or early 20th century fashion. Prominently visible is a historical streetlamp in the foreground. Horse-drawn carts and early motor vehicles suggest a transition period before widespread automobile use. There is a visible sign that reads 'Theater Restauration'.
